mapper.sql: sr.id, sr.department_id AS departmentId, sr.doctor_id AS doctorId, sr.patient_id AS patientId, sr.schedule_id AS scheduleId, sr.patient_name AS patientName, sr.patient_age AS patientAge, sr.patient_phone AS patientPhone, sr.reservation_status AS reservationStatus, sr.visit_status AS visitStatus, sr.register_status AS registerStatus, sr.creat_time AS reservationTime, d.department_name AS departmentName, doc.name AS doctorName
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO simple_reservation(department_id, doctor_id, patient_id, schedule_id, patient_name, patient_age, patient_phone, reservation_status, visit_status, register_status, creat_time) VALUES(#{departmentId}, #{doctorId}, #{patientId}, #{scheduleId}, #{patientName}, #{patientAge}, #{patientPhone}, #{reservationStatus}, #{visitStatus}, #{registerStatus}, #{reservationTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE simple_reservation SET department_id = #{departmentId}, doctor_id = #{doctorId}, patient_id = #{patientId}, schedule_id = #{scheduleId}, patient_name = #{patientName}, patient_age = #{patientAge}, patient_phone = #{patientPhone}, reservation_status = #{reservationStatus}, visit_status = #{visitStatus}, register_status = #{registerStatus}, creat_time = #{reservationTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM simple_reservation sr LEFT JOIN department d ON sr.department_id = d.department_id LEFT JOIN doctor doc ON sr.doctor_id = doc.doctor_id ORDER BY sr.creat_time DESC
